units.source_text: 我从箱根回到轻井泽，学校已放暑假。

en.t: When I returned from Hakone to Karuizawa, school had already let out for summer vacation.

units.source_text: 接受军训的学生队伍开进了这个国际避暑胜地，可以听见枪声。

en.t: Groups of students receiving military training marched into this international summer resort, and gunfire could be heard.

units.source_text: 我的二十多位亲友也离开文坛被征入伍，参加了海军进攻汉口的战役。

en.t: More than twenty of my friends and relatives also left the literary world, were conscripted, and took part in the navy's campaign to attack Hankou.
I was rejected and did not go into military service.

units.source_text: 我在观战记上这样写道：据说从前在战时就很流行围棋，军人在阵地上对弈的佳话也为数不少。

en.t: In my game commentary I wrote this: it is said that in earlier times Go was very popular during wartime, and there were many admired stories of soldiers playing matches at the front.

units.source_text: 日本武道和艺道的精神息息相通，同宗教的教义也是息息相通的。

en.t: The spirit of Japanese martial ways and artistic ways is deeply connected, and it is also deeply connected with religious teachings.
Go is the best symbol of this.
